prompt: Suppose the theatre asks for the receipt before the parcel is deposited. Can the kiosk meet the new request?
promptZh: 假設劇場要求在投入包裹前先提供收據，自助機能配合這項新要求嗎？

options.text: Yes, as long as it has the theatre’s name.
options.zh: 可以，只要有劇場的名稱。
options.whyZh: 自助機的收據雖可列名稱，卻不能在投入包裹前印出。

options.text: Yes, because pickup will not be until tomorrow.
options.zh: 可以，因為快遞要等到明天才收。
options.whyZh: 快遞何時收件不影響印收據的先後順序。

options.text: No, because the kiosk cannot print the receipt until the courier collects the parcel.
options.zh: 不行，因為自助機要等快遞收走包裹後才能印收據。
options.whyZh: 不必等快遞收走，投入包裹時就能取得收據。

options.text: No, because the kiosk cannot print the receipt until the parcel is put in.
options.zh: 不行，因為包裹投入後，自助機才能印出收據。
options.whyZh: 收據只能在投入包裹後印出，和劇場的新要求順序相反。

explanationZh: 收據只能在投入包裹後印出，和劇場的新要求順序相反。
evidence: It prints a dated receipt with the recipient’s name, but only after you drop off the parcel. The courier emptied it at four, so anything going in now won’t leave until tomorrow. / That may work for the theatre, then. They said the parcel could leave tomorrow, as long as we send the receipt before six tonight.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: It prints a dated receipt with the recipient’s name, but only after you drop off the parcel. The courier emptied it at four, so anything going in now won’t leave until tomorrow.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: That may work for the theatre, then. They said the parcel could leave tomorrow, as long as we send the receipt before six tonight.

vocabulary.note: 此處指把包裹投入快遞自助機，完成投件後才出收據。
